mapper.select: SELECT pli.id, pli.uuid, pli.project_list_id AS projectListId, pli.material_id AS materialId, pli.material_code AS materialCode, pli.item_name AS itemName, pli.model, pli.brand, pli.unit, pli.quantity, pli.unit_price AS unitPrice, pli.total_amount AS totalAmount, pli.source_type AS sourceType, pli.remark, pli.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, pli.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, pli.create_time AS createTime, pli.create_user AS createUser, pli.update_time AS updateTime, pli.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list_item pli LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON pli.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON pli.auditor_user = au.id WHERE pli.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT pli.id, pli.uuid, pli.project_list_id AS projectListId, pli.material_id AS materialId, pli.material_code AS materialCode, pli.item_name AS itemName, pli.model, pli.brand, pli.unit, pli.quantity, pli.unit_price AS unitPrice, pli.total_amount AS totalAmount, pli.source_type AS sourceType, pli.remark, pli.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, pli.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, pli.create_time AS createTime, pli.create_user AS createUser, pli.update_time AS updateTime, pli.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list_item pli LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON pli.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON pli.auditor_user = au.id WHERE pli.project_list_id = #{projectListId} ORDER BY pli.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_list_item ( uuid, project_list_id, material_id, material_code, item_name, model, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, source_type, remark, entry_user, auditor_user, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{projectListId}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{itemName}, #{model}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{sourceType}, #{remark}, #{entryUser}, #{auditorUser}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
